$comment: Hand-maintained half of /now. Everything else on that page is read from the repository at build time — see src/lib/now.ts for why. Guarded by scripts/check-now.mjs, which fails CI if currentWave names a folder that does not exist or a blocker points at a PR that has since closed.

blocked.why: The package is finished and its CI is green, but the publish token returns E401. A new npm token has to be issued by hand; nothing in the repo can unblock this.
